items.title: Reduce manual work with expanded Availability Blocks in Mews Operations
items.summary: Availability Blocks in Mews Operations have been expanded to keep group bookings accurate from setup through arrival: multiple occupancy levels and rates within the same space category, accurate pick-up tracking as guest counts change, automatic inheritance of product rules from a parent rate, adding existing reservation groups to a block without rebuilding it, an updated report to spot blocks needing attention, and connected-space relationships factored into availability.
items.pitch: Group bookings used to mean manual workarounds to keep occupancy, rates, products, and pick-up in sync. Availability Blocks now handle that automatically, so Sales, Reservations, and Revenue teams spend less time reconciling and more time selling.
items.segmentation: Available to all users except Strawberry properties

items.title: Germany E-Invoicing (Tier 2)
items.summary: Mews now supports Germany's B2B e-invoicing requirements, accepting both Peppol BIS Billing 3.0.18 and XRechnung formats (EN 16931 compliant), including the B2G Leitweg-ID requirement for public-sector transactions. Affects roughly 1,058 German PMS customers ahead of the phased mandate (reception from 2025, sending required 2027-2028).

items.title: Norway B2B e-Invoicing — coming soon
items.summary: In-app 'coming soon' notice for Norwegian customers ahead of a Peppol/EHF e-invoicing integration (via Mews Marketplace with Invopop, reusing the Belgium/Denmark engine), targeted for GA end of September 2026. Norway's new mandate requires structured B2B e-invoices from 1 January 2027; affects 300+ Mews properties there.
items.segmentation: Norway segment only; targeted GA end of September 2026

items.title: Mews → Flexkeeping Task Sync
items.summary: Mews tasks now sync automatically and in real time to Flexkeeping: a task created in Mews appears in the correct Flexkeeping user-group queue within 30 seconds, and completing it in Flexkeeping updates Mews automatically with no duplicate entry required.

items.title: Reconcile your books faster — Trial Balance by week, month, or any period
items.summary: The Trial Balance moves from daily-only Excel/PDF exports into a live, interactive report inside Mews Operations. Finance teams will be able to select any date range, view summarized ledger data directly in Mews, and export to Excel, CSV, or PDF via the Export queue.
items.segmentation: Segmented release to US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico — targeted late September 2026

items.title: Manage languages and services on Central products (Mews Multi-Property)
items.summary: Central products can now support multiple languages, which automatically propagate to local-level products. Central and local-level products can also now be connected via a Central service directly, instead of a service key.
items.pitch: Central products just got more flexible — multiple languages roll down to every local property automatically, and linking products no longer means juggling service keys.

items.title: Automate financial reporting — scheduled exports for deposit & guest ledgers
items.summary: Properties can now set up recurring, scheduled exports for the deposit and guest ledgers, with custom frequency and automatic delivery, instead of running these exports manually every time.
items.pitch: No more remembering to pull deposit and guest ledger exports by hand — set the schedule once and the data lands automatically, right when finance needs it for reconciliation.

items.title: Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS
items.summary: Properties can now configure Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS — recording expected daily or per-stay guest spend on services beyond the room (dining, spa) — so rate recommendations reflect total revenue potential, not just room revenue.
items.pitch: Properties already earn real money from dining, spa, and other on-property spend — this lets that spend inform the room rate itself. Position it as sharper pricing intelligence, not a new upsell feature.

items.title: Ledger Activity Report focused on meaningful movements
items.summary: The Ledger Activity Report now hides self-balancing postings that net to zero within the selected date range, groups remaining entries by source item, and gives every 0% VAT posting its own zero-value entry in the tax ledger.
items.pitch: Frame it as a clarity upgrade — meaningful movements are easier to find, and the tax audit trail is now complete for 0% VAT postings.

items.title: Charts added for feature parity between Mews RMS and Atomize
items.summary: Two additional charts added to the daily view in Mews RMS, closing a feature-parity gap with Atomize ahead of full consolidation onto Mews RMS.

items.title: Duna — reported GA as default KYB provider
items.summary: A #rnd cross-post said Duna is now live as the default KYB (Know Your Business) provider for business/merchant verification, replacing Trulioo for new submissions (existing in-flight Trulioo verifications unaffected). No independent confirmation found in #prod-roadmap-updates, Jira, or the public changelog — treat scope and customer impact as unconfirmed.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Automations, Guest Messaging & Nova — targeting GA October 1
items.summary: #gtm-rnd states Mews Automations, Guest Messaging, and Nova are targeting a joint GA on October 1, 2026. The Automations beta was extended to October 1 to finish a pre-activation safety-review agent (screens automations for misuse/mistakes before going live); Guest Messaging is available today only to Early Access customers with Automations enabled. Not currently confirmed via #prod-roadmap-updates, Jira, or the public changelog — as of this refresh, Automations is no longer listed on releases.mews.com either. Explicit internal instruction: hold all announcements (PR, LinkedIn, release notes) until October 1; customers asking about Guest Messaging can have their enterpriseId shared in #rnd-foh-guestjourney to be flipped on early.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers. Do NOT announce Automations, Guest Messaging, or Nova before October 1.
